description: Retrospective planning permission for the erection of a single storey rear extension; Erection of a replacement front bay window, installation of replacement windows and a new entrance door to the front elevation; Roof repairs and weatherproofing works; Rendered external wall finishes and erection of a front boundary wall to 1m high, in connection with a change of use from storage (Class B8) to an Office (Class E).
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The development results in an unsympathetic alteration to the original building that fails to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Park Town Conservation Area. The proposal would result in harm to the significance of the Conservation Area, which is not outweighed by public benefits. The development is therefore contrary to Section 72(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Policies LP1 and LP3 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), and Sections HE4.1, HE4.2, HE6.1, HE6.4 and HE9.1 of the NPPF (2026).

Reason : 2 - The application, by reason of insufficient information regarding flood risk, fails to clearly demonstrate that the proposal would avoid or reduce the risk of flooding from all sources, including fluvial, tidal, surface water, groundwater and sewer flooding, adequately account for the impacts of climate change, or ensure that flood risk would not increase elsewhere. As such, the proposal is contrary to Policy LP12 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 3 - The application proposes a new independent office use (Class E). Policy LP33 promotes and protects office space in Central Activity Zones, Town Centre, Local Centres and defined edge of centre sites. Applications for new office development located outside of these identified areas will only be supported where this would not undermine the function of these sequentially preferable locations, as identified through a sequential test. A test has not been submitted alongside this application. Therefore, the development does not comply with Policy LP33 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 4 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to make available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
